description: Golden effective-working-directory resolution corpus (SC-CWD-RESOLVER-CONTRACT). Each case gives a Bash command string and `expect`, the statically-resolved effective working directory of the first git invocation: an absolute path, "" for the session cwd (no cd/-C), or "DENY" when the directory depends on a value not in the command text (a variable/unexpandable cd or -C target). The canonical resolver is git-gate.sh (invoked as `--print-eff-dir <command>`); the Go worktree gate mirrors this corpus at git-tools/worktree-gate/detect/testdata/cwd-corpus.json, pinned content-equal by a test.
